(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of cooling fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, and an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: The lamp of claim 1 wherein said light emitting diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body.

(Currently Amended) Claim 8: The lamp of claim 7 wherein at least one light emitting diode resides on each face of said columnar body.

(Currently Amended) Claim 9: The lamp of claim 8 wherein one cooling fin resides on each corner of said columnar body.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said cooling fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 150 W/ mK.

(Currently Amended) Claim 13: The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises one of an Edison screw base or a wedge base.

(Currently Amended) Claim 16: A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 150 W/ mK, a cooling fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, said lamp having a general A19 outline.

(Currently Amended) Claim 20: The method of claim 17 wherein said elongated hollow body has substantially straight side walls.
